newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY FORINT ENDS A SHADE FIRMER VS DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY FORINT ENDS A SHADE FIRMER VS DOLLAR.

text.p: The Hungarian forint gained a fraction against the dollar but softened againt the currency basket in what dealers called light activity.
The forint closed at 177.45/50 to the dollar, compared to 177.52/57 at opening.
The gap that separates the forint from the central bank's bid, widened to 20 pips from 10 pips at the start of trading.

"This widening may stem from the fact that the expiry of March (currency) futures on the Budapest Commodity Exchange approach and certain banks have started to close their positions," said Peter Luczo of Inter-Europa Bank.
The forint trades in a 4.5 percent intervention band against a currency basket made up 70 percent of the German mark and 30 percent of the U.S. dollar.
